Diagnosis:
CAUSE: Deployment `load` in namespace `shop` runs three busy loops of `wget http://search` that drive CPU on the `search` pods to 173% of request, so HPA `shop/search` scales to its maximum of 3 replicas and stays there.

EVIDENCE:
1. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe -n shop hpa search`: Min replicas 1, Max replicas 3, `3 current / 3 desired`, metric `cpu (percentage of request) 173% (17m) / 50%`, condition `ScalingLimited True TooManyReplicas: the desired replica count is more than the maximum replica count`. (Verified by triage.)
2. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe -n shop hpa search`, Events: `2m42s Normal SuccessfulRescale New size: 3; reason: cpu resource utilization (percentage of request) above target`, preceded by `2m57s Warning FailedGetResourceMetric ... no metrics returned from resource metrics API`. (Verified by triage.)
3. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe -n shop deployment load`: revision 1, `OldReplicaSets: <none>`, `NewReplicaSet: load-55fdc5b776`, container `load` (image `docker.io/library/busybox:1.37`), command `for i in 1 2 3; do (while true; do wget -q -O /dev/null http://search; done) & done; wait`, limits `cpu: 500m`, requests `cpu: 10m`. (Verified by triage.)
4. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab top pods -n shop` (reported by diag-k8s, not re-run by triage): `load-55fdc5b776-8rpks` uses 498m CPU, while `search-5ccfdcf4cf-kmzb8`, `search-5ccfdcf4cf-chsv2` and `search-5ccfdcf4cf-rv5pv` use 15m to 22m each.
5. `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe -n shop deployment search` (reported by diag-k8s, not re-run by triage): revision 1, image `nginx:1.27-alpine`, container requests `cpu 10m`, limit `cpu 200m`, unchanged, so the `search` workload itself is not misconfigured.

FIX (not applied): scale the load generator to zero with `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab scale -n shop deployment/load --replicas=0`, which stops the `wget` loops so the HPA can scale `search` back down.

Fact.Name: source
Fact.Value: the load comes from the Deployment `load`, which calls `search`

Fact.Name: fix (not applied)
Fact.Value: raise `maxReplicas` within bounds, or the CPU request; or stop the load if it is not legitimate
